The utility model provides a biological incubator of genetic engineering, includes the box, puts thing ring, drive arrangement and supporter, the supporter put the thing ring with drive arrangement all is located in the box, drive arrangement with box fixed connection, put the thing ring with drive arrangement's power take off end fixed connection, the supporter with it rotates to connect to put the thing ring. Such genetic engineering biological incubator, its simple structure, the operating personnel of being convenient for get and put article have higher security simultaneously.
本实用新型提出了一种基因工程生物培养箱，涉及基因工程的技术领域。一种基因工程生物培养箱，包括箱体、置物环、驱动装置和置物架，所述置物架、所述置物环和所述驱动装置均位于所述箱体内，所述驱动装置与所述箱体固定连接，所述置物环与所述驱动装置的动力输出端固定连接，所述置物架与所述置物环转动连接。这样的一种基因工程生物培养箱，其结构简单、便于操作人员取放物品，同时具有较高的安全性。

Biological incubator of genetic engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a genetic engineering's technical field particularly, relates to a genetic engineering biological incubator.

Background

Genetic engineering (also known as gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology) is a genetic technology which is based on molecular genetics as a theoretical basis and takes modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology as means to construct hybrid DNA molecules in vitro from genes from different sources according to a pre-designed blueprint and then introduce the hybrid DNA molecules into living cells so as to change the original genetic characteristics of organisms, obtain new varieties and produce new products. The gene engineering technology provides a powerful means for the research of the structure and the function of the gene.

In genetic engineering, the use of a biological incubator is indispensable, and the biological incubator refers to a temperature-controllable box device mainly used for culturing microorganisms, plants and animal cells. But current genetic engineering biological incubator, it puts the thing board for the plane, and the operating personnel of not being convenient for when using places the culture dish in the incubator and puts the rear side of thing board, can lead to the culture dish accident to fall over, produces biological safety problem.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a genetic engineering biological incubator, its simple structure, the operating personnel of being convenient for get and put article, have higher security simultaneously.

The embodiment of the utility model is realized like this:

the embodiment of the application provides a genetic engineering biological incubator, include the box, put thing ring, drive arrangement and supporter, above-mentioned supporter, the aforesaid are put thing ring sum above-mentioned drive arrangement and are all located above-mentioned box, above-mentioned drive arrangement and above-mentioned box fixed connection, the aforesaid is put thing ring sum above-mentioned drive arrangement's power take off end fixed connection, above-mentioned supporter and the aforesaid are put thing ring and are rotated and be connected.

The utility model discloses an in some embodiments, above-mentioned supporter includes bracing piece, two side bearers and places the case, and above-mentioned bracing piece is connected with the aforesaid thing ring rotation of putting, and above-mentioned two side bearers set firmly respectively in above-mentioned bracing piece both sides, and the aforesaid is placed the case and is located above-mentioned bracing piece downside, and the aforesaid is placed the case all with two above-mentioned side bearers fixed connection.

In some embodiments of the present invention, the placing box has a weight block on the lower side, and the weight block is fixedly connected to the placing box.

In some embodiments of the present invention, the placing box is provided with an anti-collision plate, and the anti-collision plate is a sponge.

In some embodiments of the present invention, the above-mentioned placing box inner side is provided with a clamping device.

The utility model discloses an in some embodiments, above-mentioned clamping device includes resilient means and push pedal, and above-mentioned push pedal is located the above-mentioned incasement of placing, and above-mentioned resilient means's one end and above-mentioned push pedal fixed connection, above-mentioned resilient means's the other end and the above-mentioned incasement lateral wall fixed connection of placing.

In some embodiments of the present invention, a reinforcing rib is disposed between the object-placing ring and the driving device.

In some embodiments of the present invention, the number of the article placing frames is three, and the three article placing frames are sequentially disposed on the outer peripheral side of the article placing ring.

In some embodiments of the present invention, the box body includes a box door, and the box door is slidably connected to the box body.

In some embodiments of the present invention, the door includes an electric control layer, and the electric control layer is electrically connected to the driving device.

Compared with the prior art, the embodiment of the utility model has following advantage or beneficial effect at least:

the incubator comprises the storage rack, the storage ring and the driving device which are all positioned in the incubator body, the incubator body provides support and protection for the storage rack, the storage ring and the driving device, and foreign matters are prevented from damaging the storage rack, the storage ring and the driving device, so that the incubator is prevented from being damaged, and the reliability of the incubator is improved; the driving device is fixedly connected with the box body, so that the driving device is prevented from falling off from the box body in the using process of the incubator; above-mentioned put thing ring sum above-mentioned drive arrangement's power take off end fixed connection, when drive arrangement's output rotated, it rotates to put the thing ring to drive, simultaneously above-mentioned supporter and the aforesaid are put the thing ring and are rotated and be connected, the box is located the front side and puts the thing frame and fill with the back, drive arrangement drives and puts the thing ring rotation, it is rotatory to the box front side with empty supporter, the operating personnel of being convenient for continues to place article such as culture dish, the problem that traditional planar storage platform back row article are difficult to take is effectively avoided, the security of genetic engineering biological incubator has been increased, prevent that operating personnel from smashing the experiment culture dish, cause potential safety hazard and economic loss.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present invention clearer, the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are some, but not all, embodiments of the present invention. The components of embodiments of the present invention, as generally described and illustrated in the figures herein, may be arranged and designed in a wide variety of different configurations.

Thus, the following detailed description of the embodiments of the present invention, presented in the accompanying drawings, is not intended to limit the scope of the invention, as claimed, but is merely representative of selected embodiments of the invention. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative efforts belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

It should be noted that: like reference numbers and letters refer to like items in the following figures, and thus, once an item is defined in one figure, it need not be further defined and explained in subsequent figures.

In the description of the embodiments of the present invention, it should be noted that, if the terms "center", "upper", "lower", "left", "right", "vertical", "horizontal", "inner", "outer" and the like indicate the position or positional relationship based on the position or positional relationship shown in the drawings, or the position or positional relationship which is usually placed when the product of the present invention is used, the description is only for convenience of description of the present invention and simplification, but the indication or suggestion that the device or element to be referred must have a specific position, be constructed and operated in a specific position, and therefore, the present invention should not be construed as being limited thereto. Furthermore, the terms "first," "second," "third," and the like are used solely to distinguish one from another and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance.

Furthermore, the terms "horizontal", "vertical", "overhang" and the like do not require that the components be absolutely horizontal or overhang, but may be slightly inclined. For example, "horizontal" merely means that the direction is more horizontal than "vertical" and does not mean that the structure must be perfectly horizontal, but may be slightly inclined.

In the description of the embodiments of the present invention, "a plurality" means at least 2.

In the description of the embodiments of the present invention, it should be further noted that unless explicitly stated or limited otherwise, the terms "disposed," "mounted," "connected," and "connected" should be interpreted broadly, and may be, for example, fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected; can be mechanically or electrically connected; they may be connected directly or indirectly through intervening media, or they may be interconnected between two elements. The specific meaning of the above terms in the present invention can be understood according to specific situations by those skilled in the art.

Example 1

As shown in fig. 1, 2, 3 and 4, the embodiment of the present application provides a genetic engineering biological incubator, which includes a case 1, a placing ring 4, a driving device 5 and a placing frame 6, wherein the placing frame 6, the placing ring 4 and the driving device 5 are all located in the case 1, the driving device 5 is fixedly connected with the case 1, the placing ring 4 is fixedly connected with a power output end of the driving device 5, and the placing frame 6 is rotatably connected with the placing ring 4.

In this embodiment, the article placing shelf 6, the article placing ring 4 and the driving device 5 are all located in the box body 1, and the box body 1 provides support and protection for the article placing shelf 6, the article placing ring 4 and the driving device 5, so as to prevent foreign matters from damaging the article placing shelf 6, the article placing ring 4 and the driving device 5, further damage to the incubator, and increase the reliability of the incubator; the driving device 5 is fixedly connected with the box body 1, so that the driving device 5 is prevented from falling off from the box body 1 in the using process of the incubator; above-mentioned put thing ring 4 and above-mentioned drive arrangement 5's power take off end fixed connection, when drive arrangement 5's output rotated, will drive and put thing ring 4 and rotate, simultaneously above-mentioned supporter 6 is put thing ring 4 with the above-mentioned and rotates and be connected, box 1 is located the supporter 6 of front side and fills the back, drive arrangement 5 drives and puts thing ring 4 rotatory, it is rotatory to 1 front side of box with empty supporter 6, be convenient for operating personnel continue to place article such as culture dish, the problem that traditional planar storage platform back row article are difficult to take is effectively avoided, gene engineering biological incubator's security has been increased, prevent that operating personnel from smashing the experiment culture dish, cause potential safety hazard and economic loss.

Example 2

As shown in fig. 1, 2, 3 and 4, in this embodiment, the article placing shelf 6 includes a support rod 601, two side frames 602 and a placing box 603, the support rod 601 is rotatably connected to the article placing ring 4, the two side frames 602 are respectively and fixedly disposed at two sides of the support rod 601, the placing box 603 is disposed at a lower side of the support rod 601, and the placing box 603 is fixedly connected to the two side frames 602.

In this embodiment, the article placing rack 6 includes a supporting rod 601, two side frames 602, and a placing box 603, the supporting rod 601 is rotatably connected to the article placing ring 4, the supporting rod 601 is directly connected to the article placing ring 4, a rod-shaped structure of the supporting rod 601 is convenient for the article placing ring 4 to be fixed, meanwhile, the rod-shaped structure is convenient for the supporting rod 601 to rotate with the article placing ring 4, the weight of the article placing rack 6 is heavier, so that the article placing rack 6 is always upward, and an operator can take and place articles conveniently; the two side frames 602 are respectively and fixedly arranged at two sides of the support rod 601, so that the connection stability of the side frames 602 and the support rod 601 is ensured; the placing box 603 is positioned at the lower side of the supporting rod 601, so that an operator can conveniently place articles in the placing box 603, and meanwhile, the placing box 603 is prevented from influencing the matching between the supporting rod 601 and the article placing ring 4; the placing box 603 is fixedly connected with the two side frames 602, the two side frames 602 provide support for placing the box 603, and the two side frames 602 play a role in connecting the placing box 603 and the supporting rod 601, so that the stability of the overall structure of the storage rack 6 is ensured, and meanwhile, operators can conveniently take and place experimental articles and culture dishes.

In some embodiments of this embodiment, a weight 605 is disposed on the lower side of the placement box 603, and the weight 605 is fixedly connected to the placement box 603.

In the above embodiment, the weight 605 is disposed on the lower side of the placement box 603, so that the weight of the placement frame 6 is increased, the placement frame 6 is prevented from shaking excessively when the placement frame 6 and the placement ring 4 rotate, the center of gravity of the placement frame 6 is lowered, the placement frame 6 is prevented from being turned over laterally when an operator accidentally hits the placement frame 6, articles in the placement frame 6 are dropped, and potential safety hazards are generated; the weight 605 is fixedly connected with the placing box 603, so that the weight 605 and the placing box 603 are prevented from falling off, and the safety of the genetic engineering biological incubator is improved.

In some embodiments of this embodiment, an anti-collision plate is disposed inside the placing box 603, and the anti-collision plate is a sponge.

In the above embodiment, the placing box 603 is provided with an anti-collision plate inside, the anti-collision plate is made of sponge, and the anti-collision plate can prevent the fragile articles from being placed too hard by an operator to break the articles, thereby further increasing the safety of the genetically engineered biological incubator; the anti-collision plate is made of sponge, the sponge is soft in texture, the cost is low, and the production cost of the incubator is favorably reduced.

Example 3

As shown in fig. 1, 2, 3 and 4, in this embodiment, on the basis of some embodiments, a clamping device 604 is disposed inside the placing box 603.

In this embodiment, the clamping device 604 is disposed on the inner side of the placing box 603, and when an operator places an experimental article in the placing box 603, the clamping device 604 can clamp the placed experimental article, so as to ensure the safety and reliability of the placed article in the placing box 603.

In some embodiments of this embodiment, the clamping device 604 includes an elastic device 642 and a push plate 641, the push plate 641 is located in the placing box 603, one end of the elastic device 642 is fixedly connected to the push plate 641, and the other end of the elastic device 642 is fixedly connected to an inner sidewall of the placing box 603.

In the above embodiment, the push plate 641 is located in the placing box 603, one end of the elastic device 642 is fixedly connected to the push plate 641, the other end of the elastic device 642 is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the placing box 603, when an experimental article is placed in the placing box 603, the experimental article pushes the push plate 641 away and extrudes the elastic device 642, and then the push plate 641 continuously extrudes the experimental article, so that the position of the experimental article in the placing box 603 is relatively static, the experimental article is ensured not to fall off due to the shaking of the shelf 6, and the safety of the incubator is improved.

In some embodiments of this embodiment, the resilient means 642 is a spring. The spring has simple structure, convenient replacement and lower cost.

Example 4

As shown in fig. 1, 2, 3 and 4, in the present embodiment, in addition to the above embodiments, a reinforcing rib 3 is provided between the placing ring 4 and the driving device 5.

In this embodiment, the reinforcing rib 3 is disposed between the object placing ring 4 and the driving device 5, the reinforcing rib 3 can increase the reliability of the connection between the object placing ring 4 and the driving device 5, and meanwhile, the bearing capacity of the object placing ring 4 is increased, so that more object placing frames 6 can be hung in the object placing ring 4, and the loading capacity of the genetic engineering biological incubator is improved.

Example 5

As shown in fig. 1, 2, 3 and 4, in the present embodiment, in addition to the above embodiments, there are three article placing frames 6, and the three article placing frames 6 are sequentially provided on the outer peripheral side of the article placing ring 4.

In the embodiment, there are three racks 6, and three racks 6 can be loaded with more experimental articles; three above-mentioned supporter 6 is located above-mentioned thing ring 4 periphery side in proper order, makes to put thing ring 4 atress more even, prevents to put the too big damage that causes of thing ring 4 of the local atress of thing ring 4, has increased genetic engineering biological incubator's durability.

Example 6

As shown in fig. 1, 2, 3 and 4, in the present embodiment, on the basis of some of the above embodiments, the box body 1 includes a box door 2, and the box door 2 is slidably connected to the box body 1.

In this embodiment, the box body 1 includes a box door 2, and an operator can open the box door 2 to place an experimental article in the box body 1; the box door 2 is connected with the box body 1 in a sliding way, so that the possibility that the box door 2 collides with foreign matters is increased due to inward opening or outward opening of the box door 2, and the safety of the genetic engineering biological incubator is improved.

In some embodiments of the present invention, the door 2 includes an electrical control layer 201, and the electrical control layer 201 is electrically connected to the driving device 5.

In the above embodiment, the door 2 includes the electrical control layer 201, the electrical control layer 201 is electrically connected to the driving device 5, and when the door 2 is opened, the electrical control layer 201 sends an electrical signal to the driving device 5 to rotate the driving device 5, so that an operator can place an experimental article conveniently.

To sum up, the embodiment of the present invention provides a genetic engineering biological incubator, wherein the storage rack 6, the storage ring 4 and the driving device 5 are all located in the box body 1, the box body 1 provides support and protection for the storage rack 6, the storage ring 4 and the driving device 5, and prevents foreign objects from damaging the storage rack 6, the storage ring 4 and the driving device 5, which further causes damage to the incubator, thereby increasing the reliability of the incubator; the driving device 5 is fixedly connected with the box body 1, so that the driving device 5 is prevented from falling off from the box body 1 in the using process of the incubator; above-mentioned put thing ring 4 and above-mentioned drive arrangement 5's power take off end fixed connection, when drive arrangement 5's output rotated, will drive and put thing ring 4 and rotate, simultaneously above-mentioned supporter 6 with the above-mentioned thing ring 4 that puts rotates and is connected, box 1 is located the front side thing frame 6 and fills the back, drive arrangement 5 drives and puts thing ring 4 rotatory, it is rotatory to 1 front side of box with empty supporter 6, be convenient for operating personnel continue to place article such as culture dish, the problem that traditional planar thing platform back row article are difficult to take is effectively avoided, gene engineering biological incubator's security has been increased, prevent that operating personnel from smashing the experiment culture dish, cause potential safety hazard and economic loss.

The above is only a preferred embodiment of the present invention, and is not intended to limit the present invention, and various modifications and changes will occur to those skilled in the art. Any modification, equivalent replacement, or improvement made within the spirit and principle of the present invention should be included in the protection scope of the present invention.
